content: Insert one suppository rectally. This may be done up to four times per day, particularly at night, in the morning, or after a bowel movement that could aggravate hemorrhoids. To use the suppository, follow these steps: 1. Detach one suppository from the strip. 2. Remove the foil wrapper before insertion. Hold the suppository with the rounded end facing upward. 3. Carefully separate the foil tabs by inserting the tip of your fingernail at the end marked peel down. 4. Slowly and evenly peel apart the foil by pulling the tabs down on both sides to expose the suppository. Avoid tearing the foil. 5. Remove the exposed suppository from the wrapper. 6. Insert one suppository into the rectum. This can be done up to four times daily, especially at night, in the morning, or after each bowel movement. For children under 12 years of age, use is dependent on the patient’s condition and whether the benefits outweigh the risks. For individuals aged 12 years or older, insert one suppository rectally, up to four times daily, particularly at night, in the morning, or after bowel movements that may exacerbate hemorrhoids. This product is for rectal use only. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage unless directed by a healthcare professional. Consult a healthcare professional if you have been diagnosed with heart disease, high blood pressure, thyroid disease, diabetes, or difficulty urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland. Additionally, seek medical advice before use if you are currently taking prescription medications for high blood pressure or depression. Discontinue use and consult a physician if: Hemorrhoids worsen or do not improve within seven days. Bleeding, redness, irritation, swelling, pain, or other symptoms develop or increase. An allergic reaction occurs. Keep this product out of the reach of children. If swallowed, seek medical help or contact a Poison Control Center immediately. Phenylephrine is an alpha-adrenergic agonist that induces localized vasoconstriction and reduces inflammation. Cocoa butter provides moisturizing and lubricating effects. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk, making this product generally acceptable for use during pregnancy. Copyright © 2010 First DataBank, Inc.
